items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: You told me that Joey Gallo was your manager once. ... Joe Gallo also managed Stan Getz. ... That's who you're with.

ctx.x: You told me that Joey Gallo was your manager once. How did that happen?

Well, it was one of America's top wealthy families. She told me -- this girl in this family told me that Joey her was joint interest with our accountant. And he could help me in my profession. Joe Gallo also managed Stan Getz. It's the same people who managed Stan Getz. And that's who it was, Joe Gallo. I went to the crazy house and got out of the a new contract when I found out who he was. That's in the book, all that's in the book.
